name: Adhata Global Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Adhata Global Ltd
is in the business of trading in Timber[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AGL manufacturers and deals in:
a) Laminates, veneers, pre-laminated board, decorative laminates, decorative laminated sheets, high pressure laminates, post forming laminates, decorative veneers, etc.
b) Ready to install doors, door sets, fire rated doors, etc.
c) Veneered engineered flooring and all types of flooring
d) Particle Board of all kinds and descriptions 
e) Paper based and plastic based products 
f) Wood, ply-wood, pulpwood, match-wood, hardwood, wood based products, etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.89 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -17.2% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -56.4% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 415 days.
Working capital days have increased from 47.8 days to 119 days
